stories.title: Sen. Bernie Sanders unveils bill to ban artificial superintelligence and create Department of AI
stories.simple_summary: A senator introduced a bill that would ban very advanced AI systems and create a government department to oversee AI. This is a proposal — it hasn't become law yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large AI companies and investors right now. Most ordinary people and small business owners can ignore this for now.

stories.title: Opinion | Jensen Huang vs. the A.I. Doomers
stories.simple_summary: This is an opinion article about disagreements between business leaders and people worried about AI dangers. No specific news happened.
stories.why_it_matters: Nothing you need to act on — this is just people arguing about AI's future.

stories.title: How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms
stories.simple_summary: Experts warn that if the government puts strict limits on AI development (called a 'freeze'), it could help big companies stay powerful and make it harder for smaller companies to compete.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business, rules that are too strict could accidentally make it harder for you to use AI tools, while large companies find ways around the rules.

stories.title: How would AI actually ‘kill all humans’? Here are the top five most likely scenarios | Toby Walsh
stories.simple_summary: An expert wrote an opinion piece listing possible worst-case scenarios about AI, like humans being harmed. No new actual event happened.
stories.why_it_matters: Nothing you need to act on — this is speculative thinking about unlikely future scenarios.

stories.title: ‘We’re already fighting yesterday’s battle’: Greece’s prime minister gets candid about AI
stories.simple_summary: Greece's leader said that no government — including his own — is truly prepared for how much AI will change society in the coming years.
stories.why_it_matters: This honestly reflects reality: leaders are scrambling to understand AI just like everyone else, which suggests rules and support for businesses may take time to develop.

stories.title: Trump wants AI to be called 'super intelligence'. Will it work?
stories.simple_summary: Former President Trump wants AI companies to use the term 'super intelligence' instead of 'artificial superintelligence.' The article questions whether this naming change will actually stick.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you — it's just a debate about what to call AI systems.

stories.title: OpenAI wants to consult elite mathematicians about how to not fumble again
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI had embarrassing problems with how it handled mathematics research, so now it's hiring real mathematicians as advisors to help it handle research better in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — it shows OpenAI is trying to fix its reputation problems.

stories.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit’s agenda revealed: Unlock fundraising, hiring, and AI insights in Boston on November 4
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference is advertising upcoming talks for business founders about fundraising and AI. This is a promotional announcement.
stories.why_it_matters: Only relevant if you're thinking about starting a tech company — otherwise, nothing you need to know.

stories.title: Opinion | Cartoon by Mike Smith
stories.simple_summary: This is a political cartoon. No actual news here.
stories.why_it_matters: Nothing — this is just an illustration expressing an opinion.

stories.title: Beyond killer robots: China's real AI threat to America is already here, experts warn
stories.simple_summary: Experts are warning that China poses a real competitive threat to America in AI technology development. No specific new event is described.
stories.why_it_matters: This is geopolitical discussion mostly affecting government policy and tech companies — nothing specific you need to do.

stories.title: Snorkel AI triples valuation to $3.5B as demand for AI training data booms
stories.simple_summary: A company called Snorkel AI, which helps train AI systems using data, raised a large investment and is now worth $3.5 billion because many companies need help with AI data.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to investors — it shows the AI industry is growing. For a small business, it means companies providing AI services are doing well.

stories.title: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run
stories.simple_summary: A company called Rabbit released a new AI tool that works on regular computers (Windows, Mac, or Linux) without needing to buy their special hardware device.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business, this is just one more AI tool option becoming available — worth watching if you need help automating tasks, but nothing urgent.
